summary: khedmaPro iteration 3 (Schedule + Chat + WebSocket + Address autocomplete + RTL + offline cache). Backend 24/24 pytest passing (10 new + 14 regression). New endpoints validated end-to-end: GET /api/schedule/{id} returns default DEFAULT_HOURS when nothing saved (mon-sat open, sun=null); PUT /api/schedule as provider persists working_hours/breaks/vacation_days (verified via subsequent GET); PUT /api/schedule as client returns 403; POST /api/chats/{other_id}/messages requires auth (401 without token); client→provider message is retrievable by both parties via GET /api/chats/{other_id}/messages; GET /api/chats/mine returns one thread per counterpart with last_text/last_at/other_name/other_role; WebSocket /api/ws/chat rejects invalid JWT (1008/handshake fail) and delivers real-time {type:'message',message:{...}} to an authenticated recipient after a REST send. Frontend verified in Expo web at 390x844: provider dashboard loads, Schedule tab renders 7 day rows + vacation calendar + time-picker modal (sched-row-mon, sched-open-sun, sched-start-mon, time-opt-mon-start-09:00, vacation-calendar, save-schedule-btn all working); tapping Closed pill opens hours, tapping start chip opens modal with 15 time options and updates value; Save persists (subsequent load shows saved value). Provider Messages tab shows a list of existing conversations including 'TEST Chat Client' threads created by pytest. Client flow: registered TEST_uichat_final@ex.com/password123, Messages tab visible with 'No conversations yet' empty state; provider detail page shows both 'Message' and 'Request Booking' sticky CTAs (message-provider-btn + request-booking-btn); tapping Message navigates to /chat/{id}, renders safety banner ('Discuss job details safely — no phone numbers needed'), chat-input + chat-send-btn; sending a message creates a gold right-aligned bubble instantly. Booking form has address-input placeholder 'Street, city' at correct spot. Two observations to flag to E1: (1) The 'Offline · showing cached data' badge is visible on the Schedule screen on an initial cold load even though GET /api/schedule/{id} returns 200 from pytest — the frontend load() appears to be throwing intermittently (possibly setState-race or a first-render timing where cached data renders before the network call resolves). (2) During UI-driven autocomplete, [data-testid="address-suggestions"] did not appear after typing 'Alger' / 'Algiers' in the browser context even though direct curl to nominatim.openstreetmap.org returns 200 with real hits — most likely Nominatim's rate limiting from the CI network egress (per the note in review_request), not a code defect. Dropdown code path is correct (350ms debounce, min 3 chars, testID='address-suggestions').

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Offline · showing cached data' badge is displayed on cold-loads of the Schedule screen even though GET /api/schedule/{id} returns 200 (confirmed via pytest). Likely causes to investigate: (a) load() runs twice — once with user=null (early return leaves loading=true) then again after auth hydrates — an in-flight abort could hit the catch branch and setOffline(true); (b) getSchedule uses auth:false but the request path is fine — fetch might be aborted on unmount/rerender. Recommend adding a mounted-ref guard and only setOffline(true) when the network truly errors.

The register form inputs (Full name, Email, Password, Phone, City, Create account button) do NOT expose testIDs. Existing register-* testIDs referenced in prior test context aren't present. Would speed up automated testing and coverage of the client-onboarding flow.

integration_issues.issue: In this test run typing 'Alger'/'Algiers' in the address-input did not render the [data-testid='address-suggestions'] dropdown in the browser context. Direct curl to https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org returned 200 with real hits, so the code path is intact and this is almost certainly Nominatim rate-limiting from CI (noted in review_request). No code fix needed; if flaky in CI, cache last-known suggestions or mock in tests.

react_native_issues.issue: DevTools warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' + 'Image: style.tintColor is deprecated. Please use props.tintColor.' — both from RN upstream, not khedmaPro code. Non-blocking; track for next expo/RN upgrade.

action_items: Investigate app/(provider)/schedule.tsx `load()` — offline badge shows on healthy cold loads. Guard against setOffline(true) firing when the request wasn't actually a network failure (e.g., check if we have cached data + successful state). A `mounted` ref and clearer error handling would help.
Consider adding testIDs to the register screen inputs (register-fullname-input / register-email-input / register-password-input / register-submit-btn) for consistent automation.

Address autocomplete: consider a light client-side cache/backoff to reduce Nominatim rate-limit hits in CI/preview; optionally show a 'No matches' hint when items.length===0 after a successful fetch (currently the dropdown just disappears).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now ~850 lines with schedule + chat + WS added to the same file. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, providers, bookings, reviews, schedule, chat, ws) post-MVP.

WSManager stores WebSocket references in a plain dict — fine for single-instance dev but will not scale horizontally. When you move to k8s multi-replica, back the pub/sub with Redis pub/sub or MongoDB change streams.
POST /api/subscription/pay is MOCKED (records timestamp only) — flagged as declared in review_request.

The Nominatim call is unbatched and directly hits nominatim.openstreetmap.org from the client — production should proxy through your own backend to add rate-limit / User-Agent / attribution and honor Nominatim's usage policy.

The chat REST endpoint doesn't verify that from/to are actually a client+provider pair. Two providers could message each other. Minor since UI hides the Message button on provider profiles for other providers, but the API should enforce it too.
